hero.tears-of-ashan.akaris.name: Akaris
hero.tears-of-ashan.akaris.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Centaurs, Centaur Captains, and Centaur Rangers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every level (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.ariana.biography: Once, Ariana was a Necromancer, but seduced by the power of the Void, she betrayed the cult of the Spider Queen and struck a deal with the Netherlord Sandro. She shares Sandro's goal of destroying all of creation, though she never truly understood his motivations and how dangerous the Void really is. Above all, she is attracted by the tremendous powers the Void offers to those who embrace it. She has met Vein before, though the magic of the Void has a tendency to distort memories. She is cold, calculating, and constantly drunk with her Void-fuelled powers.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ariana.name: Ariana
hero.tears-of-ashan.ariana.specialty.des: Allied undead units have a 10% chance to age enemies (Ghost Dragons gain +10% chance on top of their base 20% chance).
hero.tears-of-ashan.atlas.biography: Atlas has ever been used to playing a large supportive role in the lives of the humans and other species. This stalwart defender has existed long before Bracaduun fell and was part of the cohort that helped to reform Bracada. He has become a symbol of stability among the wizards and a hulking rallying flag for his kin.
hero.tears-of-ashan.atlas.name: Atlas
hero.tears-of-ashan.atlas.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of allied Giants, Titans, and Colossi by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.atlas.specialty.name: Giants
hero.tears-of-ashan.balindar.biography: Balindar was the first in Bracada to test the Enrothean technology of using the best steel armor to create statues slated for animation, rather than regular rock, ore, or even precious metals. The rigid-minded golem-building academicians did not welcome this innovation, so Balindar's works, although far superior to their prototypes, still bear the experimental status.
hero.tears-of-ashan.balindar.name: Balindar
hero.tears-of-ashan.balindar.specialty.d: Increases the Speed of allied Steel Golems by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up). Can upgrade Stone Golems, Iron Golems, and Magnetic Golems to Steel Golems.
hero.tears-of-ashan.biara.biography: Arguably the most dangerous weapon in the Demon Sovereign's arsenal, Biara is a succubus of legendary skills. With ample natural gifts enhanced by almost masochistic self-discipline, her talents for seduction, assassination, and infiltration are unequalled in all of Sheogh. When the going gets tough, Kha-Beleth gleefully turns to Biara.
hero.tears-of-ashan.biara.name: Biara
hero.tears-of-ashan.biara.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of allied Hell Steeds and Nightmares by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 6 levels (rounded up). Can gate Nightmares with Expert Gating.
hero.tears-of-ashan.biara.specialty.name: Hell Steeds
hero.tears-of-ashan.cordelia.biography: Serving as a crusader under the Holy Inquisition, Lady Cordelia commands the fortress guarding the ravine of Nelsham’s Scar on the southern border of the Bull Duchy. It is said that Cordelia is the only woman who has ever pierced the hard heart of the Great Inquisitor Salvatore – not through any womanly charms mind you, but rather via her uncompromising faith in Elrath, with which she has condemned many a heretic’s soul to a slow and gruesome death. For her accomplishments, Cordelia was tasked with keeping an eye on the Necromancers settling the Heresh Valley beyond the Scar. She couldn’t have dreamt of a better reward.
hero.tears-of-ashan.cordelia.name: Cordelia
hero.tears-of-ashan.cordelia.specialty.d: Cordelia's creatures are permanently enchanted with Fire Shield.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ellaine.biography: Ellaine served honorably in the Imperial army during the War of the Eclipse and then returned to manage her family's estates in a wise, compassionate, and just manner. Though it had been poorly kept her steady hand yielded fruit: the manor grew and prospered. Now that Ellaine is back at war, the peasants remember her good deeds and show miracles of bravery at the battlefields under her command.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ellaine.name: Ellaine
hero.tears-of-ashan.ellaine.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Pikeman, Halberdiers, and Glaviers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every level (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.euryale.biography: Being a middle child does not usually grant one great memories of their youth. Thankfully, Euryale and her sisters never fought much, growing into strong and learned women as the centuries flew by. They have always been fiercely protective of each other and their kin, particularly since certain egotistical humans have historically attempted to hunt medusae for glory. None have succeeded where Euryale has stood guard.
hero.tears-of-ashan.euryale.name: Euryale
hero.tears-of-ashan.euryale.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Medusas, Medusa Queens, and Medusa Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.findan.biography: More a poet and diplomat by taste and training than a warrior, Findan is less comfortable than many of his brethren in fighting at close quarters with a sword. He vastly prefers to strike quickly, and strike hard, but from a distance. His favorite tactic is to first weaken the enemy with a rain of well-aimed arrows.
hero.tears-of-ashan.findan.name: Findan
hero.tears-of-ashan.findan.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
hero.tears-of-ashan.gotai.biography: A promising young war chief, Gotai's grim intensity separates him from other Orcs. While he shared their sense of clan loyalty, he was extremely - almost irrationally - loyal to Quroq, the warchief who adopted him when his own parents were killed by Yetis. With Quroq's passing, however, Gotai must find his own place in the world. Given his skills, that place is likely to be a lofty one.
hero.tears-of-ashan.gotai.name: Gotai
hero.tears-of-ashan.gotai.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of allied Behemoths, Ancient Behemoths, and Ghost Behemoths by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.gotai.specialty.name: Behemoths
hero.tears-of-ashan.grok.biography: Grok's promotion as the Sovereign's "go-fer" was due to two things: his innate indefatigability and the Sovereign's love for massacre. He is his master's bloody entertainments manager, driving all manner of game and beings before Kha-Beleth to be slaughtered. The Sovereign knows that if there is a matter that must be handled quickly, there is no better fiend for it than the slavishly obedient and mindlessly brutal Grok.
hero.tears-of-ashan.grok.name: Grok
hero.tears-of-ashan.grok.specialty.descr: Gates a stack of Imps, Gogs, and Hell Hounds at the start of battle.
hero.tears-of-ashan.grok.specialty.name: Gate Master
hero.tears-of-ashan.gwenneth.biography: Gwenneth was once a handmaiden to Queen Catherine Ironfist herself, but as Catherine went to war, Gwenneth found herself wrapped up in clerical studies. She became incredibly learned and is keen on sharing her newfound knowledge.
hero.tears-of-ashan.gwenneth.name: Gwenneth
hero.tears-of-ashan.gwenneth.specialty.d: Increases the maximum learning level of spells taught and learned by Scholar by 1 per level of Scholar.
hero.tears-of-ashan.haggash.biography: Haggash, an orphan found wandering in the steppes near Qutugh during the Year of the Sea of Manes, was taken in by a tribe of Centaurs and raised as one of them. Once a leader of Centaur troops, she found Erathian Centaurs to be much less fearsome than she had hoped. She subsequently turned her interest to taming a much more ferocious 4-legged beast: the multi-headed Hydra.
hero.tears-of-ashan.haggash.name: Haggash
hero.tears-of-ashan.haggash.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Hydras, Chaos Hydras, and Ruinous Hydras by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.havez.biography: Havez has an eye for anything that is quirky or odd. His personal effects are an unusual mix of items from all over Ashan - shadow silk cloths from Ygg-Chall, leatherwork from Irollan, jewels from the Dwarven mines, etc. His interest in the quaint and curious extends to his troops as well, he has for many decades studied the Gremlins and specializes in the upbringing and training of these lizard-like humanoids.
hero.tears-of-ashan.havez.name: Havez
hero.tears-of-ashan.havez.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of allied Gremlins, Master Gremlins, and Gremlin Mechanics by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every level (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.havez.specialty.name: Gremlins
hero.tears-of-ashan.hrimnir.biography: Hrimnir's labrys is known to bite with bitter hoarfrost as well as its wicked blades, hence his title of "Harbinger of Frost", allegedly bestowed unto him by the Ancients themselves. He prefers to lead his armies up front, charging at his enemies like an Argali let loose in a village.
hero.tears-of-ashan.hrimnir.name: Hrimnir
hero.tears-of-ashan.hrimnir.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Jotunns and Jotunn Warlords by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.ixchel.biography: The deserts of Ravage Roaming are a far cry from the tunnels of Nighon, but Ixchel is no stranger to these lands. Some say she is the descendant of a long-forgotten goddess, though she denies these claims entirely, chalking it up to people taking folk tales too seriously. Only she knows where she truly came from, and she is intent on keeping that, along with her peculiar bond with Couatls, a lifelong secret.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ixchel.name: Ixchel
hero.tears-of-ashan.ixchel.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Couatls and Crimson Couatls by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.jormungandr.biograph: Jormungandr hails from the heavens and was summoned by Regnan sorceresses in an effort to make peace with the local sea serpent population. Appeased by his followers' dedication and reverence, he descended to them in a slightly less earth-shaking form to command the vicious water-dwelling serpents in battle.
hero.tears-of-ashan.jormungandr.name: Jormungandr
hero.tears-of-ashan.jormungandr.specialt: Increases the Speed of allied Sea Serpents, Haspids, and Deep Serpents by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.kaspar.biography: Kaspar was a great doctor and healer who was able to cure even the most terrible wounds. Delving deeper and deeper into the secrets of life and death, Kaspar made a particularly risky experiment that went wrong... and brought him to the realm of the dead. Though he now leads an undead army, his knowledge of anatomy and the treating of wounds remains unparalleled.
hero.tears-of-ashan.kaspar.name: Kaspar
hero.tears-of-ashan.kaspar.specialty.des: Casts Poison at the start of battle.
hero.tears-of-ashan.kastoreTOA.biography: Kastore is an Elven sorcerer and one of the Adventurers of Terra. While originally from the world of Terra, he is the ruler of Deyja and Terra Nova. His early attempts focused on locating the mythical Ancients, but were later abandoned due to the lack of success. As the king of Deyja, the bulk of his new plans consisted of the renaissance of the Heavenly Forge. While he achieved some progress, such as the creation and mass-production of Dreadnoughts, his schemes ultimately failed.
hero.tears-of-ashan.kastoreTOA.name: Kastore
hero.tears-of-ashan.kastoreTOA.specialty: Increases the Speed of allied Dreadnoughts and Juggernauts by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.khabeleth.biography: Kha-Beleth is an Arch-Demon with no master, and no past. Nobody knows from whence he came. Unlike other demons who constantly feed on scraps from their overlords, Kha-Beleth relies fully on his own resources, a trait which proves him a powerful figure in the complicated world of infernal politics. He makes no secret of what he wants: nothing less than destruction of the walls of Sheogh, and freedom for the children of Urgash. With his near-infinite patience, his fearlessness, his brilliant mind, and his charismatic manner, he may one day realise his lofty goals.
hero.tears-of-ashan.khabeleth.name: Kha-Beleth
Increases the Speed of allied Devils, Arch Devils, and Arch Demons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.laurielle.biography: A faithful servant of Eltath for twenty-three centuries past, Laurielle is an Angel who survived the Elder Wars, but not before coming face-to-face with Azkaal, the Prince of Destruction, himself. Manning the battlements of the great flying city Albanora, Laurielle was struck down by the legendary Demon Lord with a searing blow whose memory still haunts her to this very day.
hero.tears-of-ashan.laurielle.name: Laurielle
Increases the Speed of allied Angels, Archangels, and Seraphim by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.ludmilla.biography: Born the daughter of the Duke of Bull, Ludmilla found from a young age that the politics of court were about as volatile and world-changing as a mouse's wind. Instinctively grasping for a surer, faster form of power, Ludmilla found herself living a secret life as she fell in with a den of Necromancers who had great plans for the future. When one of their number, a lascivious Vampire, became her lover, she took to wearing a studded collar as a coded symbol of her blossoming rebellion - that or to cover the bite marks. It was only a matter of time before she took the ritual, and became a Vampire herself. Immortality is such a boon when you're a power-hungry sybarite.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ludmilla.name: Ludmilla
hero.tears-of-ashan.ludmilla.specialty.d: Increases the Speed of allied Bone Dragons, Ghost Dragons, and Spectral Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.maeve.biography: Brilliant but embattled, Maeve is a dedicated ruler working desperately to pull a doomed empire out of its downward spiral. Trying to salvage a future for the fragmenting Falcon Empire while fighting off a Demon invasion, Maeve has nothing to rely on but her own dedication to the ideals of chivalry and her unswerving faith in the worship of the Dragon of Light.
hero.tears-of-ashan.maeve.name: Maeve
hero.tears-of-ashan.maeve.specialty.desc: Casts Haste with effect increased by 3 for level 1–2 creatures, by 2 for level 3–4 creatures, and by 1 for level 5–6 creatures.
hero.tears-of-ashan.maeve.specialty.name: Przyśpieszenie
hero.tears-of-ashan.merikh.biography: Once a Sherif of the Seven Cities, Merikh remained a stern agent of the law after being turned into an Undead by Archon Belketh himself. It was Merikh who presided over the trial of the nefarious Nethermancer Sandro, banishing him from the Wizard lands. When Sandro returned, some sixty years later, he had not forgotten Merikh's role in his exile, and perpetrated his revenge by trapping his soul within a ghoul's body. It took Belketh several years and a great amount of power to track down the creature and salvage Merikh's essence, binding it to a more appropriate vessel: a black suit of armour. Relentless, unbendable and incorruptible, Merikh has become a terrifying embodiment of Justice.
hero.tears-of-ashan.merikh.name: Merikh
hero.tears-of-ashan.merikh.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Grim Guards, Black Guards, and Dread Guards by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.naadir.biography: Naadir despises the world of flesh, even more so than his fellow Necromancers. To him, perfection is only to be found in the naked spirit, cleansed from its material impurities. On the battlefield, his intimate knowledge of the spirit world allows him to "capture" the souls of his enemies and use them as reinforcements to his own forces.
hero.tears-of-ashan.naadir.name: Naadir
hero.tears-of-ashan.naadir.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Mummies by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 3 levels (rounded up). Can upgrade Walking Dead, Plague Zombies, and Rot Zombies to Mummies.
hero.tears-of-ashan.pariah.biography: A demon from the depths of Ashan, Pariah is far more powerful than any and all Kreegan Pit Lords. He prefers the company of Devils more than any lesser demon. Most frighteningly, he possesses surreal magical capabilities that rival most seasoned mages and warlocks.
hero.tears-of-ashan.pariah.name: Pariah
hero.tears-of-ashan.pariah.specialty.des: Gating Devils costs 25% less spell points. Can gate Arch Devils with Expert Gating, but spell point cost is unaffected.
hero.tears-of-ashan.salvatore.biography: Salvatore, the Great Inquisitor, is a cold, pedantic man who has dedicated his life to Elrath, the Dragon of Light. Raised by a devout priest and priestess couple, he is a believer in absolute truths and has no time for anybody who follows the creed of any other Dragon – or superstition. His limited intelligence, allied with his very good memory, leaves Salvatore swift to judge and slow to forget those who don’t share in his unquestioning faith. Those found to be heretics in the eyes of this man, who has never known love, should not expect a short or merciful death.
hero.tears-of-ashan.salvatore.name: Salvatore
Salvatore's Monks, Zealots, and Priests can cast Fireball instead of attacking.
hero.tears-of-ashan.sanctus.name: Sanctus
hero.tears-of-ashan.sanctus.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Green Dragons, Gold Dragons, and Diamond Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.sinithala.biography: Sinithala is very old, old enough to remember a time when the Shantiri Empire still ruled most of the known lands, and Irollan's dominions spread as far south as Yon-Chall Forest. Of course, being an Elf, it would be very hard to guess her age just from her looks. Sinithala knows her time will come soon, though, but she is not willing to abandon her beloved forest. She is already making preparations to be reincarnated as a Dryad after her death.
hero.tears-of-ashan.sinithala.name: Sinithala
Increases the Speed of allied Pixies, Sprites, and Faeries by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every level (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.stratus.name: Stratus
hero.tears-of-ashan.stratus.specialty.de: Increases the Ballista's Attack and Defense skills by 30% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.tempest.name: Tempest
hero.tears-of-ashan.tempest.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of allied Air Elementals, Storm Elementals, and Hurricane Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.tears-of-ashan.wilhelm.biography: Wilhelm's zealotry made him the ideal candidate to lead the new Inquisition formed to fight the growing threat of the Necromancers of Heresh. Few know his subsequent experiences during the War of the Broken Staff sparked a secret interest for Dark Magic. While he remains a loyal servant of the Dragon of Light, Wilhelm now realizes you cannot hop to defeat what you don't understand. Of course, if they knew, the rest of the clergy would question Wilhelm's sanity.
hero.tears-of-ashan.wilhelm.name: Wilhelm
hero.tears-of-ashan.wilhelm.specialty.de: Increases the damage of Fire Magic spells by 15 per level.
hero.tears-of-ashan.ymoril.biography: Hailing from Hammer Fall, Ymoril Redshield is a young captain trained by Konrad Wolf in person. Ymoril lost her parents at a very young age and Konrad, who had just been appointed governor of the city, adopted her as his own daughter. Ymoril grew into a capable fighter but also a wise administrator, and she has the full trust of her foster father. Ymoril has no memories of the night of her parents' death, but she knows they were slaughtered by Demons, just as she knowst how Konrad risked his own life to track down the demonic assassins and avenge their victims.

skill.core.artillery.description.advance:
{Advanced Artillery}

Advanced Artillery gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista shoots twice and has a 75% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. The Cannon has an increased chance to hit fortifications and inflicts 200% base Damage to creatures. The Ballista and the Cannon cannot be dealt more than 40% of their Health as Damage from any single damage source.
skill.core.artillery.description.basic:
{Basic Artillery}

Basic Artillery gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista has a 50% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. The Cannon has an increased chance to hit fortifications. The Ballista and the Cannon cannot be dealt more than 40% of their Health as Damage from any single damage source.
skill.core.artillery.description.expert:
{Expert Artillery}

Expert Artillery gives the hero control of the Ballista, Arrow Towers, and the Cannon. The Ballista shoots thrice and has a 100% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. The Cannon precisely hits fortifications at maximum Damage and inflicts 300% base Damage to creatures. The Ballista and the Cannon cannot be dealt more than 40% of their Health as Damage from any single damage source.

spell.core.bless.description.advanced:
{Advanced Divine Strength}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict damage greater than their normal maximum damange in combat by 1. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead.
spell.core.bless.description.basic:
{Basic Divine Strength}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict maximum damage in combat. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead.
spell.core.bless.description.expert:
{Expert Divine Strength}

Causes all friendly units to inflict damage greater than their normal maximum damange in combat by 1. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead.
spell.core.bless.description.none:
{Divine Strength}

Causes the selected friendly unit to inflict maximum damage in combat. Removes Curse effect. Does not affect undead.
spell.core.bless.name: Divine Strength
spell.core.dispel.description.advanced:
{Advanced Cleansing}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and Poison from a friendly or hostile unit. Ignores target creature's natural immunities to magic.
spell.core.dispel.description.basic:
{Basic Cleansing}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and Poison from a friendly unit. Ignores target creature's natural immunities to magic.
spell.core.dispel.description.expert:
{Expert Cleansing}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and Poison from all units on the battlefield and destroys all magic obstacles. Ignores target creatures' chances to resist spells and natural immunities to magic.
spell.core.dispel.description.none:
{Cleansing}

Removes all spells and effects except Disrupting Ray and Poison from a friendly unit. Ignores target creature's natural immunities to magic.
spell.core.dispel.name: Cleansing

spell.core.prayer.description.basic:

spell.core.prayer.description.expert:

spell.core.prayer.description.none:

{Expert Levitation}
